common_meaning: A rapidly rotating neutron star that emits beams of radiation.

transfer_boundary: Discovery route is Cosmic; no [COS] tag is assigned. Close to neutron star (N). Rotation alone is not enough: the beam must cross our line of sight; pulsars are seen in radio, optical, X-ray and gamma rays.

common_meaning: Punishment that does nothing to repair the harm.
